precision_note: Forward bitwise parity against production is checked on every benchmark run. Full VJP finite differences cover32/64-bit CPU/CUDA; float32 near-converged CG requires1e-2 perturbations after a step-size sweep to resolve the small initial-state derivative above rounding noise.
capture_note: Graph setup is included in first forward/backward calls. First calls may also compile kernels; warm calls reuse per-stream cached programs. Native CUDA graph storage is outside the device-pool metric.
